_comment: Ground truth read from the source files in this directory, never from the index. Each entry states what a human reading the corpus would answer for `scouter impact <query> <this dir>`. `known_false_positives` is a ratchet: a name listed there is a caller Scouter reports that is not a caller; an empty list means any extra caller fails the measurement.

symbols.why: Unique name, called from core.pipeline and uses_direct.direct. Nothing calls those two, so the transitive blast radius is exactly these two direct calls.

Unique name reached three ways: a call through the import alias `c.boost`, a bare reference passed to map, and a bare reference passed to functools.partial. All three are callers a human would name; the string in decoys.mention is not. All three are recorded as known false negatives because the measured answer is empty.
Two different functions share this name: core.transform and decoys.transform. A correct answer refuses the ambiguity instead of merging them.
